The Celtics defeated the Raptors, 98-93 tonight in Toronto. Jayson Tatum finished with a team-high 24 points along with 8 assists and 7 rebounds for the Celtics, while Derrick White tallied 19 points, 7 assists and 3 three pointers in the game. Ja'Kobe Walter recorded 17 points, 5 three pointers and 3 rebounds. The Celtics improve their record to 10-2 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 5-6 for the season.
